decisions.statement: A running seat is stopped whatever place that seat has.
A stopped interactive seat is resumed into a terminal.
A stopped headless seat is revived without a terminal.
A reset attaches only where the seat has the interactive place.
A name that is no seat name is refused rather than put in a command line.
A seat name is lower-case letters or digits or hyphens after a letter or digit.
A row's context value names whether the seat runs and where that seat is.
A seat row is offered only the menu items the manifest hangs on the agent view.
Nothing here reads a notice page or names a notice.

definition: the steps a run or a reset asks of a seat, and the line a terminal attaches by
